h: King Mitchy alleges Burna Boy never paid VeryDarkMan's ₦250m and says school was built with NGO funds
p: Content creator King Mitchy has allegedly claimed that Burna Boy never paid the ₦250 million reportedly pledged to VeryDarkMan, and that a school project was funded by an NGO instead. The claims have not been confirmed by either party.
more: Neither Burna Boy nor VeryDarkMan had publicly responded at the time of reporting.
The claim has stirred debate among fans of both sides online.
